title: A focused launcher run of a non-test check (doc-link checker) gets "use a supported test runner form" guidance
outcome: When a session runs `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- <command>` with an inner command that isn't a test runner (e.g. `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`), the host's notice says plainly that the command is not a recognized test runner and earns no Test record. It doesn't tell the caller to use "a supported test runner form" or imply that a rerun could earn credit, and it doesn't present the run as a failure.
acceptance: For a focused launcher run whose inner command is not a recognized test runner, the host notice names the inner command, says no Test record will follow because that command isn't a test runner, and gives no advice to rerun or change the form for credit.
The notice reports the command as the agent ran it (the inner launcher command), or names the shell wrapper separately, rather than presenting the runtime's pwsh -Command wrapper as the command text.
A regression test covers a non-test focused command and a genuinely unsupported test-runner form, and they get distinct notices.
